final_draft.answer: Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer word for word (control CC8.1, valid until 2027-11-18). It only covers the default branch of the application repository, harborlight/app. It doesn't say whether other repositories have the same rule, and the answer doesn't claim they do.

arguments.query: code review approvals required before merge to main branch

answer:9f900621-640f-4600-a8b6-3240f722c: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:118313d6-c793-4642-a797-2ed535d61: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:ba7d7e65-de63-429a-8ade-5255549fe: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:1b8264ac-51ee-44f3-8921-e2c9a11ba: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:1ad4feb6-bfb4-4723-9330-1a8c48bd0: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
